name: Westfield Topanga
description: Westfield Topanga is the ultimate destination for food, fashion and fun in the San Fernando Valley. This premier shopping center features an impressive collection of luxury brands including Prada, Balenciaga, Bottega Veneta, Saint Laurent, and Cartier, alongside popular retailers and a diverse array of dining and entertainment options including AMC Theatres and upscale restaurants.
demographics: Westfield Topanga attracts an affluent, fashion-conscious demographic from the San Fernando Valley and surrounding West Los Angeles communities, with visitors typically aged 25-54 and household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area draws families and young professionals seeking premium shopping experiences, luxury brands, and upscale dining options. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for experiential retail, with visitors spending extended time at entertainment venues like AMC Theatres and destination restaurants such as STK Steakhouse and Topanga Social, alongside high-end fashion shopping at luxury boutiques.
summary: A premier luxury shopping destination in the San Fernando Valley featuring high-end fashion, upscale dining, and entertainment experiences.
